name: HVAC_2024_REGIME_ATTRIBUTION_AUDIT
explicit_prohibitions: no coefficient fitting for production use
no revision of DEV/CV selected specs
no causal attribution from temporal coincidence alone
no TEST-driven feature or threshold choice
primary_questions: When does the persistent 2024 HVAC level shift begin?
Is the HVAC increase offset by another component, suggesting category reclassification?
Does total auxiliary power rise with HVAC?
Does source PUE rise consistently with the extra auxiliary power?
Is there evidence of meter reset/schema/quantization/source-definition change?
Which publicly documented infrastructure events are temporally compatible?
What broad explanation class is defensible?

transition_localization.method: descriptive before/after window means on daily HVAC
transition_localization.candidate_scan_range: 2023-10-01 through 2024-07-31, requiring adequate coverage on both sides

confidence_hierarchy.HVAC_level_shift_exists: HIGH if data show a large persistent step
confidence_hierarchy.genuine_broader_facility_operational_or_: MEDIUM/HIGH only if compatible with public evidence AND total-aux/PUE rise

fan_wall_counterpoint: Original ESIF design already included fan-wall air-handling units. Do not infer 2024 HVAC jump = new fan walls unless a primary document says new/additional fan-wall equipment or metering was commissioned then.
